description: Deploy Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Q4_K_XL) + MTP speculative decoding on a single NVIDIA L4 24GB — GCP g2-standard-8 — via the official llama.cpp Docker image. Decode-optimized to ~91–99 tok/s (min ~91 chat, max ~99 math), lossless (full GPU residency + ECC-off).
